workflows.name: Immediate Workflow
steps: Run the 5-feature extraction loop on your training data.
Verify that features.shape reflects the 5-column structure.
Execute the LightGBM training process. The logs must explicitly show Number of used features: 5.
Once the model is retrained, rerun the extraction on the public_test directory to produce the final submission file.

workflows.name: Submission Protocol
steps: Upload: Submit directly to the challenge platform.
Archiving: If the score exceeds your current .92853, store the model object using pickle or joblib so you don't have to retrain if you need to generate a new submission version later.

workflows.name: Execution Sequence
steps: Run the cell containing your import statements and your test_dir definition.
Run the large cell containing the for img_file in tqdm(files): loop. Wait for it to finish. This is the cell that generates the features object.
Run the cell that defines train_labels_df and creates the target variable using features.index.
Run the cell that initializes model and calls model.fit().

risks.text: Any index mismatch will introduce noise, which is particularly detrimental when training on higher-dimensional feature sets.
Duplicate files in a dataset are problematic because they introduce bias during training, causing the model to overfit on repetitive samples and potentially inflating validation scores.

notes.text: Ensure that ids and the target labels are strictly aligned before the model.fit() step.
